component.name: HashCatcher
component.summary: Offline wireless capture conversion for Hashcat

description.p: HashCatcher converts wireless capture files (.cap, .pcap, .pcapng) into Hashcat-compatible 22000 hashes using hcxpcapngtool, with a batch queue, live progress, and concurrent conversion. It is intended for authorized wireless auditing, password recovery workflows, educational research, and penetration testing.
hcxtools and Hashcat are separate system packages this app shells out to - they are not bundled and must be installed separately.
